static_traits.name: Li Shiqing
static_traits.family_status: Lives alone, raising two pet dogs
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends to confide in, but they do not fully understand her Anxiety about pets; Relationship with friends affected, often canceling plans
static_traits.medical_history: No history of similar psychological problems; has not received psychotherapy yet; no major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Able to clearly describe experiences and thoughts in counseling, frequently expressing catastrophic and future-predicting worries; emotionally tense, cooperativeness Good

basic_info.main_problem: I continuously feel worry and Anxiety about the safety of my two dogs. The problem started recently: they once ran away for hours, and I immediately believed they had 'already died, disappeared forever', thereby triggering intense pain and Anxiety. Since then I keep thinking of the worst scenarios, affecting my daily life and causing significant distress; when the dogs are out of sight these thoughts repeatedly appear every day.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because persistent worry about the dog affected my mental health and daily functioning.
growth_experiences: One significant trigger event: the two dogs slipped out the yard gate when I was Distracted, running away for several hours. I immediately concluded they had already Died, never coming back again, and kept falling into worst-scenario thoughts. After this event, I maintained high Anxiety about the dogs' safety long-term, frequently having catastrophic thoughts like 'hit by a car' 'lost forever', leading to sleep, diet, Work and social life all being affected.

special_situations.event: Two dogs slipped out of the yard gate and were lost for hours
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If pets are not under control or missing, it means the worst case (Death or permanent loss) has happened
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Immediately contacts the animal shelter, posts lost-dog notices, repeatedly searches and checks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They are already dead, never coming back

special_situations.event: In daily life, whenever the dogs are out of sight
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as I cannot see them, danger is very likely to happen
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly checking pets, trying to stay home to accompany them to ensure safety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They may be hit by a car or get lost and never come back

special_situations.event: When having plans to go out or socialize with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not home watching them, things will go wrong
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Cancels social plans, prioritizes staying home to watch the pets
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: As long as I am not there, they will have an accident

special_situations.event: While at work, unable to see or confirm the dogs' status
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being unable to confirm pet safety during Work means risks are uncontrollable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attention is frequently drawn to the pet's safety; hard to concentrate on work
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Something bad may have already happened

core_conflict.wish: Longs to keep complete safety and control over an important attachment figure (the pet)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing loss and separation, worrying about catastrophic consequences (Death, permanent loss)
defense_goal: Through continuous monitoring and reducing outings to lower uncertainty and feelings of Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: A responsible caretaker who must guard them at all times
object_relations.object_representation: A fragile, easily hurt attachment object that needs protection (a pet)
not understanding, others (friends) who think I am overreacting
